prologo.notte: Sant'Arianna. On the night Clotilde died, the bell-tower clock stopped at 5:59.
prologo.stanza: Grandmother's chair is empty. On the pillow there is a half-finished lace, and a note pinned to it.
prologo.biglietto: Ada, you finish it. The sun is waiting. C.

nuova.corpo: The saved story starts again from the prologue and the Notebook is emptied. Records and unlocks stay.

sera.oggettoArriva: Someone knocks. The lagoon has left something at the door.
sera.sottoLaPorta: {n, plural, one {A note has slipped under the door.} other {# notes have slipped under the door.}}
sera.nessunBigliettino: Tonight there is nothing under the door.
sera.appunta: Pin it · {n, plural, =0 {no pins left} one {# pin left} other {# pins left}}
sera.confermaCorpo: Some notes are still undecided: they count as left, and leaving them has its consequences too.

errore.sconosciuto: This note is not from tonight.
errore.spilli: Tonight's red pins are used up: remove one to pin this note.
errore.chi: Before pinning it, choose who wrote it.
errore.senzaRichiesta: This note asks for nothing to weave.

arrivo.laguna: Someone knocks. The lagoon has left something at the door.
arrivo.mano: {nome} knocks at the door. There is something for you.
arrivo.casa: On the pillow, something of grandmother's is still waiting for you.
arrivo.niente: Tonight nobody knocks at the door.

sera.spilliFiniti: Tonight's pins are used up. To pin this note, take the pin off another one:

scelta.intro: Four notes under the door, folded in four. Only one pin.
scelta.unoSpillo: One pin only: one note only.
scelta.strappato: The note is torn. Something is still missing:

conferma.merlettaia: Stay the lacemaker, and let my mother leave freely.
conferma.seppia: Give my mother the pillow, and take a thread for myself.
conferma.chiuso: Send her away, as grandmother did.
conferma.aperto: The open stitch: nobody commands anybody any more.

scelta.piegato: The note stays folded: you have already repeated that stitch once, and whoever repeats it repeats it forever.

alba.delusione: {autore} was waiting for an answer. You thought the note came from {indovinato}.

bilancio.obiettivi: How it was meant to go
bilancio.obiettiviOk: The day happened as it should.
bilancio.obiettiviKo: The day did not go as it should.

conseguenza.fallita: For {nome} it did not go as hoped.
conseguenza.desiderio: Now I know what {nome} wishes for.
conseguenza.autoreSbagliato: The note was from {autore}, not {indovinato}: the request came to nothing.

bilancio.filoDOroNuovo: Golden thread ✦ (the first for this day)
bilancio.quiete: {n, plural, =0 {No quiet hours} one {# quiet hour} other {# quiet hours}}
bilancio.record: Record: {incroci, plural, one {# crossing} other {# crossings}}, {quiete, plural, =0 {no quiet hours} one {# quiet hour} other {# quiet hours}}
bilancio.spartitoNonCopiato: The score could not be copied.
bilancio.rigiocata: Lace replayed from the Loom: the story does not change.

bepi.salvo: Bepi came back safe from the storm.
bepi.ferito: Bepi's boat struck the shoal: he came back hurt.

lettereLivia.liberate: My mother's letters are travelling again.
lettereLivia.sepolte: My mother's letters stay buried in the well.

riconciliate.true: Teresa and Marta are speaking again.
riconciliate.false: Teresa and Marta still do not speak.

zenoLivia.true: Zeno and my mother have met.
zenoLivia.false: Zeno and my mother did not meet.

archivio.intro: Grandmother's old laces, rolled up like letters.
archivio.nuovoRotolo: There is a lace in the chest that was not there before.

esito.rammendato: Lace mended: the memory is whole again.
esito.nominato: The threads have names, but the tear remains.

telaio.intro: Every day is a knot on the strip. Touch it to replay it, resume from it or listen to it.
telaio.vuoto: The Loom is empty: no story has started yet.
telaio.riprendiCorpo: The story goes back to this day's evening: what happened afterwards will never have happened. The Notebook stays.

finale.annodato: At nine the lace knots itself.
finale.nonTieneTesto: The day does not happen like this. Weave the night again: the Notebook remembers everything.
finale.fineTesto: That year's story is over. From the Loom you can resume it from any evening.
finale.spartiti: Copy the scores of the whole game
finale.spartitiCopiati: Scores of the whole game copied.
finale.fineVero: The bell rings in tune. You found the open stitch.

titoli.ispirato: Inspired by the bobbin-lace tradition of Pellestrina and Burano.

taccuino.libroVuoto: The Book of Stitches is still closed.

stato.inArrivo: Comes true if you set the hour

taccuino.lasciaCadereCorpo: The request becomes failed, with its consequences.
taccuino.pistaFinita: There is nothing left to look for. The answers are all in the lace.

stranezze.pieroPozzo: A well: receives everything, gives nothing.
stranezze.pieroTrabocca: With three secrets the well overflows.
stranezze.ginoCorre: Never stays still two hours in a row. With a fever he stays in bed.
stranezze.ninaCuriosa: When she is on top, she takes the secrets too.
stranezze.zenoFaro: Never strays more than two places from the Lighthouse.
stranezze.lunardiCura: Never falls ill; when he is on top, he heals.
